# orbivisor_placement_rule (Resource)

A placement rule (affinity, anti-affinity, node pinning).

Manifest kind `PlacementRule`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Rule kind.
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `ha_may_violate` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `node_tag` (String)
- `nodes` (List of String) Node names.
- `vm_tag` (String)
- `vms` (List of String) VM names.
- `weight` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
